versions.content: The function Fr_SendWUP shall perform the following tasks on FlexRay CC Fr_CtrIdx: 1. Invoke the CC CHI command ‘WAKEUP’, which initiates the wakeup transmission procedure on the configured FlexRay channel. 2. Return E_OK.
